verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning of models up to 1T+ parameters on your own existing SFT datasets with no conversion. It also documents deploying the trained result on the same platform with a single firectl command, using either live merge or multi-LoRA, and serving fine-tuned models at base-model prices. A community user's report of running an SFT job on gpt-oss-20b independently confirms the training side. Missing for 10: an explicit list of which base models support fine-tuning, and independent hands-on corroboration of serving a fine-tuned model end-to-end.
